# Tester Exchange

> Gets Android developers the 12 testers × 14 days that Google Play requires before a new personal developer
> account can publish to production. Testers are real people on their own phones, and each day they open the app is
> recorded, which is the engagement Google reviews. Pay once (US$12.99 for 12 testers,
> $14.99 for 15, $22.99 for 25; card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, local methods such as UPI and Pix, or USDT/USDC on BNB Chain, Polygon,
> Arbitrum or Base sent straight to our wallet with no fee) or get testers free by testing other apps.
> Prices are shown in the visitor's own currency. Site and every guide in 55 languages.

## Fastest path for a developer (3 steps)
1. Pick a pack at https://testerexchange.com/ (or test other apps for free).
2. Tap "Connect Google Play": one Google screen signs you in, and we add our testers group to the app's closed
   testing track through the Play Developer API. Or add it by hand (Play Console → Closed testing → Testers →
   Google Groups), or use an email list instead: we show the tester emails to paste.
3. Pay. The test starts automatically when the payment lands.

## How testers are found (autopilot)
- Nobody browses or picks apps. Free: open https://testerexchange.com/earn in your phone's browser (no app needed);
  you are given apps to test automatically (paid apps first), one tap per app per day, and each app you test brings a
  tester to yours. Developers can also join free swap circles where members test each other's apps. Paid: skip testing; paid apps get
  testers before anyone else. Google's 14 days apply to everyone.
- Dropouts are replaced automatically; you only pay for days testers actually open the app, and unused credits go back to your credit balance.
- Purchases are final: credits don't convert back to money.
- After 14 days: a test report with daily activity, tester feedback and draft answers for Google's
  production-access questions.
- Bring your own testers: share https://testerexchange.com/t/<package> with friends; they join free and fill seats.

## For AI agents
- API keys: the user signs in at https://testerexchange.com/api and taps "Create API key" (format `tx_` + 48 hex).
  The key acts as that user: it can spend their credits but can't pay or delete the account.
- One call does the whole setup: `get_testers` (package_name, name?). It adds the app, opens its test, applies
  credits, and returns `human_steps` (add our Google Group in Play Console; pay with one of `buy_links`, or test other
  apps free at https://testerexchange.com/earn). Call it again any time to check progress.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no OAuth): https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
  Auth: header `Authorization: Bearer tx_…` or `?token=tx_…`. Public tools (about, platform_stats, pricing) work
  without a key.
  Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http tester-exchange https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer tx_…"`
- A2A (Agent2Agent 0.3, JSON-RPC): agent card https://testerexchange.com/.well-known/agent-card.json, endpoint
  https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/functions/v1/a2a. `message/send` with text ("get 12 testers for
  com.example.app") or a data part {"skill": "get_testers", "package_name": "com.example.app"}; same Bearer key.
- HTTP API (one endpoint): POST https://vvrlxzbngxfxddywidoq.supabase.co/rest/v1/rpc/agent_call
  headers: `apikey: sb_publishable_OwXT7OfwIGkuIn420mavVA_MsAkzZGf` (public key), `Content-Type: application/json`
  body: {"p_token": "tx_…" | null, "p_action": "get_testers", "p_args": {"package_name": "com.example.app"}}
  Actions: help, stats, pricing, open_tests (public); get_testers (start here), me, my_apps, add_app, start_campaign,
  campaign, add_testers, set_status, friends, start_friends_test, fill_from_exchange, join, my_tests, share_kit, buy_credits (key).
- OpenAPI: https://testerexchange.com/openapi.json · Agent docs: https://testerexchange.com/agents/
- What an agent can't do: the 14 days of real use on a phone, and paying (checkout needs a human).

## Facts (November 2026)
- Personal Google Play developer accounts created after 13 Nov 2023 need a closed test with at least 12 opted-in
  testers for 14 continuous days, then apply for production access with a questionnaire.
- The requirement was 20 testers until December 2024.
- Organization (company) developer accounts are exempt.
